profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am an experienced Software Engineer with experience in Software Development, Software Testing, and Verification and Validation of Safety-Critical Software. I strive to excel at all aspects of my career and I am willing and able to learn new technology and work in various realms of Software Development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Software Engineer for various projects. Develop vital Automatic Train Protection and Automatic Train Operation Software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop PC-Based Diagnostic Tool, using C#, for monitoring and event logging of onboard Advanced Train Control systems. Develop display software for Driver's Cab display units using C++ and Qt.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop a simulator for Safety Critical Train Control systems using C++ and the Agile Software Development methodology.

positions.title: Application Developer Senior
positions.description:
Develop client-specific software for Lockbox processing for multiple accounts simultaneously, using C/C++, Perl, COBOL, and JCL.

Consultant for Lockbox MIS with other Service Partners within PNC and external clients for available features and functionality for client Lockbox processing options.

Close collaboration with Lockbox Implementations team to organize, develop, and implement custom solutions for client Lockbox services.

Team-lead for researching, testing and implementing of existing and new features of the FreeBSD UNIX Operating System, and the VICOR Receivables Information Delivery Systems (RIDS).

Provide 24/7 production support for clients, acting both in a coordination role and providing on-the-fly testing and production corrections.

Maintain and create processes and procedures for Lockbox MIS technical development group.

positions.title: Engineer - Software Engineering
positions.description:
Developed application software for multiple safety-critical instrumentation and control embedded systems using C/C++.

Co-developed the Instrumentation and Control Certification Plan.

Maintained and enhanced an embedded serial communications simulation application using C/C++.

Designed and implemented various software tools to aid in debugging and troubleshooting of embedded instrumentation and control software applications using C/C++, MFC, and C#.

Lead software code inspection teams during verification of safety-critical instrumentation and control embedded software applications.

Attend industry seminars and specialized training for continued education.

Train vendor companies on the development and the verification of software for embedded instrumentation and control software applications.

Maintained U.S. government security clearance.

positions.title: Engineer - Software Verification and Validation
positions.description:
Led Software code inspection teams during verification of safety-critical instrumentation and control embedded software applications.

Designed and implemented the interface between Bettis' embedded software architecture and a commercial code coverage tool to enable code coverage testing of safety-critical embedded software using C/C++.

Developed various software tools to aid software inspectors in performing software inspections using C#, C/C++, and MFC.

Developed a serial link analysis application to ensure communication compatibility between applications before the embedded software was built and released for testing using C#.

Served as departmental safety observer to help promote a safe and secure working environment.

positions.title: Test Automation Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
Co-developed the framework of a test automation system improvement project using object-oriented Perl to replace a pre-existing C++ test automation system.

Designed the architecture for a Radio Test plug-in for the test automation system.

Developed a searchable help index for the test automation system using Perl/CGI and JavaScript.

Lead a team that successfully completed acceptance and regression testing of a test automation system.

Developed test applications to run on a test automation system.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical and Computer Engineering / Computer Science
